win_system.notes:
SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all High or Low paying symbols.

 The Free Spin symbol only appears in the base game.

multipliers.name: Multipliers
multipliers.behavior:
This game features a MULTIPLIER symbol that will multiply your wins. Every MULTIPLIER symbol that lands on the reels will reveal a value. The value shown will be added to the total multiplier displayed in the logotype. The possible multipliers are 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x and a staggering 100x! After every win, the win amount will be multiplied by the current factor displayed in the logotype.

 Look out for the 3 different colored symbols:

 Light blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 1x, 2x or 5x

 Dark blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 10x, 15x or 20x

 Striped blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 25x, 50x or 100x

 At the start of each base game spin, the multiplier is reset to 1.

modes.name: Free spins
modes.trigger: Get at least three free spin symbols to trigger the free spin feature.
modes.effects:
Get at least three free spin symbols to trigger the free spin feature. In this feature all multiplier symbols are added progressively in the logotype for the remainder of the free spins. After each free spin, the win during the current spin will be multiplied by the currently displayed multiplier.

 3 FREE SPIN symbols will give you 8 spins.

 4 FREE SPIN symbols will give you 10 spins.

 5 FREE SPIN symbols will give you 12 spins.
